chapter: After Cab: Don Redman, teaching and records
title: Moe Gale's 'holding company' and late recording payments
summary: The band was paid a year after recording, with Gale keeping the interest.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: I remember that time we made...we recorded with Cab, and they paid us a year later, on Christmas, like it was a big deal. You know, originally we called Gale a holding company. That was the name of the company, 'holding company' -- and boy, they could hold money. And we got so mad that year... We knew they got the money, because we recorded for Victor and some of the big companies, which paid off on time. But they just got the money, held it, got the percentage...
...the interest on it, and paid us on principal. And that made us look like we were getting a big deal. But we knew...
